persons.name: Pūrṇānanda
persons.evidence: śrīgurur bhaktiyuktaḥ || pūrṇānandeti nāmā samalikhad amalaṃ bhadrakalpāvadānaṃ ... śrīpūrṇānandana thavata coyā jula

date.as_written: nepāle saṃvadākhye kunavanavayute śrāvaṇē śuklapakṣe || paṃcamyāṃ vaiśvadeve parighakasahite bhānuputrasya vāre ... saṃvat 991 śrāvaṇamāsayā paṃcami(!) utra(!)bhādranakṣakra(!) parighanayoga(!) śanivāra
date.nakshatra_yoga: Vaiśvadeva (= Uttarāṣāḍhā) in verse / Uttarabhādra(pada) in Newari; Parigha yoga

purpose: svārtha: scribe wrote it for himself (thavata coyā jula)
notes: Year expressed in verse by word-numerals 'ku-nava-nava' (1-9-9 read in reverse = 991), matching the Newari 'saṃvat 991'. The verse nakṣatra Vaiśvadeva (Uttarāṣāḍhā) conflicts with the Newari 'uttarabhādra'; one is probably an error. The place phrase 'bṛṅṣādye mūlakāntye khalu suviharaṇe' is corrupt; it seems to name a vihāra but cannot be identified. 'śrīguru' is taken as an honorific title of the scribe, not a separate person. The catalogue's '(exp. 451)' is unclear (possibly a misprint or a different expected year) and does not match the colophon; colophon date NS 991 is followed. 'thavata coyā jula' (Newari) = wrote for himself, hence owner/svārtha.
